shortDescription: Add, update or delete DNS rewrite rules from AdGuardHome

options.name: answer
options.description: Value for the domain rewrite. Required when O(state=present). Value can be a CNAME, A or AAAA record.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain or wildcard domain that you want to be rewritten by AdGuardHome.

options.name: host
options.description: URL of AdGuardHome host. For example, V(https://my-adguard.my-domain) or V(http://192.168.1.2).

options.name: password
options.description: Related password for the AdGuardHome user.

options.name: state
options.description: Wether a rewrite rule should be added/updated (O(state=present)) or removed (O(state=absent)).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Ability to disable TLS certificate validation. This should only set to V(false) when the network path between the host the module is run on and the AdGuard host is fully under your control and trusted.
